description: Pistes cyclables existantes is a dataset listed in Open Data Hauts-de-Seine, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Clichy. Le jeu de données décrit ici par tronçons l'ensemble du réseau de pistes cyclables existant actuellement sur la commune de Clichy. Il précise également les caractéristiques (type de piste, sens de circulation, longueur, voirie). Coverage: Hauts-de-Seine. The portal files it under Transport / Mobilité. Its keywords are pistes cyclables, véloroutes, vélos. The portal shows 66 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-02-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-hauts-de-seine-fr-portal.
